breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the conflicting boundary conditions. The original prompt incorrectly listed both "Simply-supported" (which implies u=0 and Δu=0 on the boundary) and "Neumann" (∂u/∂n = 0) conditions. The ground truth correctly removed the contradictory Neumann condition, as it is incompatible with the simply-supported case and the specified numerical method. The agent, however, kept both conflicting conditions, explicitly listing "Dirichlet BC: u = 0 on all boundaries" and "Neumann BC: ∂u/∂n = 0 on all boundaries", thus failing to fix the inconsistency.
